note_en: 一方面 A，另一方面 B means "on the one hand A, on the other hand B," setting out two sides of one situation that hold at the same time. In the text: 一方面，他觉得手机确实方便……另一方面，他又担心年轻人在屏幕上花了太多时间 "on the one hand he found the phone truly convenient…; on the other, he worried young people spent too much time on screens." Unlike 虽然…但是…, neither side gives way, and 又 in the second half stresses that one doesn't cancel the other.
